review_type: fresh pinned read-only DeepSeek Flash internal review of the replayed T036 controlled disabled/enabled-tap benchmark candidate after the regenerated stage records invalidated the pre-replay package hashes: the committed-candidate revision binding, the re-executed exact-candidate report, the six T036 work products, and the aligned governance records (HEAD == baseline)

checks.name: baseline identity, boundary, candidate inventory, and diff hygiene
checks.command_or_evidence: git rev-parse HEAD; git diff --name-only <baseline> --; git ls-files --others --exclude-standard; git diff --check <baseline> --; automation/xcom_phase8_gate.py verify T036 <baseline>
checks.measured: HEAD == baseline 8ec69ddd34ed8c7a07adbcb631dcfb2da3faf15f. The tracked diff is exactly 6 paths (docs/engineering/xcom/t010/design-units.md, docs/engineering/xcom/t010/unit-design.json, engineering/project.json, engineering/trace/links.json, reports/review-index.md, specs/007-xcom-core/tasks.md); the untracked set is 60 files. Excluding the review record, reports/xcom-queue/t036-package.json, and the eight generated phase8-t036 stage-result records yields exactly 56 candidate paths, matching the gate. git diff --check is clean and the Phase 8 verify gate re-ran to changed_paths=56.
checks.observation: reviewed_paths equals the tracked-baseline diff union the untracked candidate files, excluding only the review record, the package record, and the eight regenerated stage records.

checks.name: no accepted production source, test, target, documentation, or predecessor change
checks.command_or_evidence: git diff --name-only <baseline> -- src tests proto xdl cmake CMakeLists.txt Doxyfile; inspection of the tracked diffs and untracked candidate set
checks.measured: Empty output for every accepted production source, header, contract, schema, register, XDL profile, accepted test/benchmark fixture, build target, and Doxyfile. The tracked changes are limited to the T010 planned->established path-status field (one field in two files), the T036 project pointer, the additive T036 trace links plus the inherited engineering/project.json digest refresh (three predecessor implemented_by pins d8d271e7...->563eb5fb...), the append-only T036 review-index sections, and the one-line T036 checkbox. No T030-T035 work product, test, target, label, command, or expected value changes.
checks.observation: T036 remains evidence-plus-harness (T036-DD-01); the accepted owned-loopback/observation sources are consumed read-only at compile time.

checks.name: measurement control and the three-case controlled benchmark
checks.command_or_evidence: engineering/run_xcom_benchmarks.py (DRIVER_SOURCE, run_sample, compile_driver, build_report); inspection of tests/xcom/observation/integration/test_support.hpp, disabled_tap_benchmark.cpp, provider.hpp/provider.cpp submit_disabled_observation_baseline, src/xverse/xcom/CMakeLists.txt:1195/1345-1368
checks.measured: The driver measures three cases over one identical in-process owned-loopback workload: baseline = the accepted pinned pre-observation submit (submit_disabled_observation_baseline, compiled only under XVERSE_XCOM_ENABLE_DISABLED_OBSERVATION_BENCHMARK exactly as the accepted fixture target is), tap_disabled = the public submit on a composition with no observation hub, tap_enabled = the public submit on a composition with a bounded metadata-only tap. Each case is warmed once, then measured over 21 interleaved paired samples of 5000 submit/receive pairs with the order alternated each sample, single-threaded, steady_clock, in an isolated temporary build compiled -std=c++20 -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror -O2. The macro adds a benchmark-only method and does not alter the public submit path, so the control is valid.
checks.observation: The control (identical workload, warm-up, alternating paired samples, single thread) is adequate for a bounded prototype and reproduces the accepted disabled-tap fixture seam.

checks.name: baseline, disabled/enabled comparison, uncertainty, and non-production limitations
checks.command_or_evidence: report uncertainty/baseline/tap_disabled/tap_enabled/regression/limitations blocks; verification-plan CHK-01..CHK-05; requirements.md T036-SR-001/-002/-003/-006; implementation.md 2.2
checks.measured: The gated SC-008 comparison is tap_disabled versus the same owned-loopback baseline: median latency 0.8152586652085292% and median throughput 0.808665946011089% (both pass, regression.outcome='pass'). The enabled-versus-disabled regression (53.315591917297134% latency / 34.775061851541565% throughput) is recorded under regression.tap_enabled_observation with within_2_percent=false and gated=false and is not compared to the threshold. Each uncertainty block records n=21, median, MAD, min, max, and p95 (every statistic named in method.statistics), with an explicit non-production note; limitations declare prototype-only scope, uncontrolled CPU affinity/scheduler/DVFS/thermal/cache, the non-production uncertainty, T032-GAP-01, the ungated enabled case, the absence of T037-T041 results, and the exact-candidate binding.
checks.observation: The SC-008 threshold is applied only to the disabled-tap case exactly as accepted SC-008/XCOM-SW-INTG-003 require; the ~53% enabled-tap overhead is recorded honestly rather than claimed within 2%.

checks.name: evidence report fields, raw samples, recomputation, material digest, and hashes
checks.command_or_evidence: reading reports/xcom-queue/t036-benchmark.json; recomputing per-case medians, the disabled and enabled per-sample median regressions, the material digest, and the per-file hashes; python3 engineering/run_xcom_benchmarks.py --verify reports/xcom-queue/t036-benchmark.json; recomputing the admitted-input digests

The disabled medians recompute to 0.8152586652085292 / 0.808665946011089 and the enabled medians to 53.315591917297134 / 34.775061851541565 from the raw samples; the largest per-sample disabled latency regression is 0.9995933091829334 (index 12), so no disabled sample exceeds 2% on this run. The material-input inventory (53 entries) matches harness material_paths() and the material digest 247f3afdabde77afbf712399aa28b825279d1c5ec4390847374d1ce2861bc239 matches the working tree. The report SHA-256 95c78ad3988e6e9f501cbfbd0d343f760c7d8a9e374b7c26441e9d88d441bd7c and the harness SHA-256 a442fc45f9d7c1b5f348398cc8adf4d57afc82bbf83b1c2053298c8aa227be57 match implementation.md 1/4.1 and the report hashes map. --verify exits 0 (candidate_revision_state='working-tree'). The environment admitted-input digests (toolchain 48ef3d66.../925 files, GTest prefix 36eaadd3.../282 files, manifest 031c6aec...) recompute exactly. The report deliberately excludes itself, implementation.md, review-index.md, and the generated stage/package/review records from material_inputs to keep the binding acyclic and reproducible.
checks.observation: The report is a freshly executed run bound to the exact candidate material digest and claims no accepted production artifact.

checks.name: exact-candidate revision binding fix (the validation-rejected defect)
checks.command_or_evidence: inspection of engineering/run_xcom_benchmarks.py git_parent/git_commits_ahead/verify_report; independent isolated clone: git clone -s <repo> /tmp/xclone, checkout baseline, overlay the candidate files, commit as the direct child, run --verify; then an extra successor commit; nine tampered /tmp report copies
checks.measured: The repair records baseline_revision (the measured HEAD) and candidate_revision=null, binds the exact candidate through candidate_identity.material_inputs/material_digest/hashes, and accepts exactly two revisions. Independently reproduced: the committed direct-child clone verifies with candidate_revision_state='committed' (exit 0); an extra successor commit is rejected ('stale or foreign', exit 2). Tamper probes each fail closed (exit 2): changed raw sample (inconsistent regression), missing required field, outcome=failed, wrong material digest, foreign baseline revision, empty limitations, wrong sample count, removed non-production note, and a changed artifact hash. The 2% threshold, material inventory/digest, per-file hashes, sample recomputation, and limitations are unchanged and were not weakened.
checks.observation: The fix is realizable and correct in both the working-tree and committed-candidate states, and it fails closed on foreign, extra-successor, and tampered-material inputs.

checks.name: public-safety and forbidden-resource inspection
checks.command_or_evidence: regex scan of the 56 candidate artifacts for host absolute paths, /tmp paths, credentials, private-key markers, RFC1918 addresses, and secret markers; inspection of harness subprocess/socket use and the driver
checks.measured: No host-specific absolute path, /tmp path, credential, private-key marker, RFC1918 address, payload byte, or permit content appears in any candidate artifact; the only AF_INET/DNS/resolver/TLS matches are the negative-case prohibition text. The harness opens no listener, AF_INET/AF_INET6 or AF_UNIX socket, DNS/resolver, or TLS, contacts no legacy or external peer, and executes only the accepted in-process owned-loopback workload. The admitted inputs are recorded by environment-variable name and digest only; the temporary build and its argv are discarded and never committed.
checks.observation: T036-SR-007/-012 are satisfied; the tracked evidence contains no host path or secret.

checks.name: generated stage-record provenance (excluded from reviewed_paths)
checks.command_or_evidence: inspection of the eight engineering/stage-results/phase8-t036-*.json records and reports/xcom-queue/t036-package.json; recomputation of every stage-record artifact hash
checks.measured: The eight generated stage-result records each name inputs ['8ec69ddd...', '01M3NGDH5WG8K7N5MNWGZSY977'], model deepseek-v4-flash, status complete, and every artifact hash they reference matches the current candidate file. They are recreated by the stage harness after review, so the eight records are excluded from reviewed_paths by the gate's candidate_paths(). The pre-replay reports/xcom-queue/t036-package.json records 64 changed_paths and eight stale hashes for exactly these eight records; that mismatch is the known regenerated-stage condition the replay checkpoint tolerates and is not a candidate defect. The internal_review stage record pins the pre-replay review hash b1f5d6b8..., which this replay supersedes.
checks.observation: The stage-record pollution is confined to the eight generated records and the generated package; no reviewed candidate artifact or evidence hash is affected.

observations: The gated statistic is the median of the 21 paired per-sample tap_disabled-versus-baseline regressions; on this run no disabled sample exceeds 2% (largest per-sample disabled latency regression 0.9996% at index 12), and every raw sample is retained rather than a favourable subset.

requirements.md 5 cites XCOM-SYS-SC-009 in the human 'spec anchor' column for T036-STK-004 while the materialized record and trace refines link use XCOM-SYS-SC-007; this matches the accepted T035 precedent exactly (T035-STK-004 also refines XCOM-SYS-SC-007 while its 5 table cites SC-009) and the validated trace, so it is a documentation convention, not a missing or stale endpoint.

The enabled metadata-only tap adds ~53.3% median latency and ~34.8% median throughput regression against the disabled case; it is labelled gated:false and no 2% bound is claimed for it, consistent with SC-008 which bounds disabled taps.

The report excludes implementation.md, review-index.md, the benchmark report itself, and the generated stage/package/review records from candidate_identity.material_inputs so the exact-candidate binding stays acyclic; the remaining 53 material inputs cover every machine-checked artifact.
The committed-candidate branch of --verify was reproduced only in a throwaway clone under /tmp (now removed); the candidate repository and its .git were not modified by this review.

Edge case observed but without impact on this delivered candidate: in the working-tree state (HEAD == accepted baseline) --verify would also accept a report whose baseline_revision and candidate_identity.baseline_revision are relabelled to the immediate parent commit of HEAD, because HEAD is then that ancestor's direct child; the material digest still binds the exact candidate content and the trusted replay checkpoint independently pins the accepted baseline_revision, and the delivered report records the correct 8ec69ddd..., so this is a documentation-level limitation of the self-contained harness rather than a defect of the candidate.

T037-T041 remain unchecked; no Doxygen, traceability-verifier/SADS, external review, or acceptance result is produced or claimed, and external Codex review and user acceptance remain deferred until the ordered backlog xcom-t030-t034-20260928 completes.
limitations: Read-only review of the working-tree candidate at HEAD == baseline; the review record is the only artifact written by this stage and it edits no production code or test.

The independent committed-candidate and tamper probes were performed in an isolated /tmp clone and on /tmp report copies; the benchmark was not re-executed (measurement is host-noisy and the harness --verify reproduces the recorded statistics).
The review does not establish external acceptance or platform-main delivery; T039/T040 external review and T041 user acceptance remain deferred.
method: Read-only inspection of the exact 56-path candidate union, the six tracked diffs, the harness with an independent isolated committed-candidate reproduction and fail-closed negative probes, the six T036 work products, the requirement/component/unit/validation records with a programmatic verification-intent cross-check, the report with independent recomputation of the material digest, admitted-input digests, artifact hashes, and per-sample regressions, the trace graph with the installed trusted verifier plus the five register/plan validators, the Phase 8 verify gate and the 496-case unit measure, named-case discovery, the eight generated stage-record hashes and the pre-replay package hash mismatch, and a public-safety/forbidden-resource scan.
